description_excerpt: Job Description • Coordinate daily trucking operations, including pickup, delivery, shipment monitoring, and exception handling. • Provide high-quality customer service to internal and external customers in line with the Company’s service standards. • Proactively monitor shipments and communicate delays, service issues, and other exceptions, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution. • Coordinate closely with trucking service providers to ensure capacity, service reliability, competitive cost, and operational compliance. • Support the sourcing, onboarding, and periodic performance evaluation…
